The article reports on the remarkable recovery of humpback whales in Brazilian waters, particularly around Guanabara Bay and Abrolhos Bank. This resurgence, following the end of whaling, has fueled a booming whale-watching industry.

The Bright Side:
This story is a clear example of how concerted conservation efforts can lead to significant ecological recovery, benefiting both wildlife and local economies through responsible tourism.

This situation exemplifies positive social physics. The collective decision to end whaling empowered the whale population to recover. Transparency about the recovery fosters a coalition for conservation, integrating tourism as a supportive force.
